花.def: flower, blossom; to spend (time or money)

ety.hint: A flower 艹 in bloom 化; 化 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 艹 (plants) for the meaning plus 化 (change) as the sound. A later character that took over the meaning 'flower' from the older 華, which drew a plant in bloom.

花.name: flower

火.def: fire, flame; to burn; anger, rage

origin.says: A drawing of flames: fire. At the bottom of characters it is often written as 灬 (fire dots).

火.name: fire
火.in: 谈爆灵炸灭灾烦恢伙烟烧灯燃煤烂秋灰炒炼碳淡炎烤烛煌炭燥炮煽焰炉毯烫灿焚炬烁炫氮瞅熄灸痰愁熔烘灶炊烙灼炕荧耿盔焊焕揪锹

甚.def: considerably; very, extremely; a great extent

origin.says: Said to be 甘 (sweet) plus 匕 (spoon), pleasure taken to excess: 'very, extreme'. Dong Chinese calls the origin unclear; the bottom now looks like 其 (its) with a hooked stroke.

甚.name: extremely

ety.hint: A false 叚 person 亻; 叚 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 叚 (to borrow) as the sound: borrowed, not one's own, hence false, fake; also leave from work, a holiday.

ety.hint: You 你 said with affection 心

origin.says: A late character: 你 (you) above 心 (heart), a respectful 'you'. 心 may also have hinted at an old final -m sound.
目 (eye) for the meaning plus 艮 (stubborn) as the sound. It first meant the eyeball itself, and later became the everyday word for eye.

From 縣: a severed head (an upside-down 首 'head') hanging by a cord 系 (rope) from a tree 木 (tree), meaning 'to hang'; it was borrowed for 'county'. The simplified form keeps only a shortened head and a bit of the cord.

讨.def: to haggle, to discuss; to demand, to ask for

ety.hint: To ask 讠 for something 寸

origin.says: 言 (speech) with 寸 (hand): asking for something with words and hands; one reading takes the right as a shortened 肘 (elbow) for the sound. Simplified from 討 by writing 言 as 讠.

讨.name: demand

拥.def: to have, to hold; to embrace, to hug; to flock, to throng

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 用 (use) as the sound: to hold in the arms, embrace. Simplified from 擁, whose sound part 雍 was replaced by the simpler 用.

拥.name: embrace

origin.says: A drawing of three mountain peaks rising from the ground.

山.name: mountain
山.in: 岁密微岛端岸摧屿崇峰癌岗崩瑞碳仙崛幽炭峻岩岂崭催喘岳灿崖峡捣徽蹦薇嵌揣峭凯岔屹岖岭峦峨崎崔秽巅巍

苏.def: to awaken, to revive, to resurrect; used in transliterations

origin.says: Simplified from 蘇: 艹 (plant) plus 穌 as the sound, an aromatic herb, then 'to revive'. The simplified form put 办 in place of 穌 as a mere stand-in shape; it also replaced 囌.

苏.name: revive

origin.says: Simplified 適 (go to, suit: 辶 walk + 啻 as the sound) was replaced by 适, an old separate character with 辶 (walk) and a sound part shaped like 舌 (tongue): suitable, comfortable.

庭.def: court; courtyard; spacious hall or yard

ety.hint: A wide 广 couryard 廷; 廷 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 广 (shelter) for the meaning plus 廷 (court) as the sound: a hall or courtyard; also a law court.

庭.name: main hall

居.def: to live, to reside; to dwell; to sit

origin.says: 尸 (a seated or squatting body) for the meaning plus 古 (ancient) as the sound: to sit, then to stay or live somewhere.

居.name: reside

ety.hint: A man 方 traveling with a pack 氏 on his back

origin.says: 㫃 (a flag on a pole) over two people: soldiers marching under a banner, a brigade. Hence a troop on the move, then travel. The people below are now a stylized shape.

差.def: difference, gap; almost, nearly; in error; an officer

ety.hint: Work 工 done by a sheep 羊; incompetence

origin.says: Wheat (來) rubbed in the left hand (𠂇, later 左 (left)): hulling grain by rubbing, the first form of 搓 (rub). It came to mean uneven, different, mistaken. Wheat and hand now look like 羊 (sheep) and 工 (work).

差.name: difference

兴.def: to thrive, to prosper, to flourish

origin.says: From 興: four hands (舁) raising an object (同): to lift, to rise, to flourish. The simplified form keeps only a sketch of the top and the two lower hands.

兴.name: thrive

ety.hint: Soil 土 crushed under pressure 厂

origin.says: Simplified from 壓: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 厭 (to satiate) as the sound, earth pressing down. The simplification kept only the 厂 (cliff) outline of 厭 and added a dot to 土 (earth).

罗.def: gauze, net; to collect, to display

origin.says: Simplified from 羅: 罒 (net) + 維 (a bird tied with string), a net for catching birds. The simplified form replaces the bottom with 夕 (evening).

罗.name: bird net

按.def: to check, to control, to push, to restrain

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 安 (at ease) as the sound: to press down with the hand, to make something settle.

按.name: press

移.def: to shift, to move about, to drift

origin.says: 禾 (grain) for the meaning plus 多 (many) as the sound: perhaps grain swaying in the wind or seedlings being transplanted, hence to move, to shift.

移.name: shift

ety.hint: A hand 爪 stamping a seal 卩

origin.says: A hand (爪) pressing down a kneeling person (卩): first 'to press down' (later 抑), then to press a seal, to stamp, to print.
贝 (shell, money) for the meaning plus 才 (talent) as the sound: riches. Simplified from 財, with 貝 (shell) written 贝.

维.def: to preserve, to maintain, to hold together

origin.says: 纟 (thread) for the meaning plus 隹 (short-tailed bird, short for 唯) as the sound: a cord that ties things, so to hold together, maintain. Simplified from 維, with 糸 written 纟.

维.name: tie together

origin.says: 月 (flesh) plus 殳, which grew out of an older picture-word for 'thigh': the thigh. Shares and strands came later, like pieces of a whole. Older dictionaries took 殳 as the sound.

监.def: to supervise, to direct, to control; to inspect; prison, jail

origin.says: Simplified from 監: a person with a big eye (臣 (eye) + 人 (person)) bending over 皿 (a basin of water) to see a reflection, to look closely, to oversee. 臣 was reduced to two strokes.

监.name: supervise

origin.says: 宀 (roof) for the meaning plus 至 (arrive) as the sound and hint: the place under the roof where you arrive and stop, a room or home.

执.def: to execute; to grasp, to hold; to keep; to sieze, to detain

ety.hint: A hand 扌 clutching a pebble 丸

origin.says: Simplified from 執, a drawing of a person with hands locked in shackles: to seize, to hold. The modern shapes 扌 (hand) and 丸 (pellet) only replace those parts in shorthand.

执.name: grasp

ety.hint: A child 儿 in a room with four walls 囗

origin.says: Four was first written with four lines. The form 四 was borrowed for its sound; it may have drawn a nose or mouth breathing out (the old meaning of 呬 'breathe').

怕.def: to fear, to be afraid of; apprehensive

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 白 (white) as the sound: a feeling in the heart, fear.

怕.name: fear

origin.says: Simplified from 輕: 車 (cart) for the meaning plus 巠 (warp threads) as the sound, first a light carriage, then light, easy. Both parts are written in short form.

营.def: camp, barracks, army; to run, to manage

origin.says: From 營: the top of 熒 (glowing) as the sound plus part of 宮 (palace, now 吕) for the meaning: lit dwellings, a camp; then to run, manage. The simplified form writes the fire top as 艹 over 冖.

营.name: camp

票.def: bank note; ticket; vote; a slip of paper

ety.hint: Flames 覀 over an altar 示, referring to a Chinese tradition of burning fake money as an offering

origin.says: Came from a form with 火 (fire) under two pairs of hands lifting something: sparks flying up. The hands became 覀 (cover) and the fire became 示 (altar), so the build is lost. Later a slip or token: ticket, vote, banknote.

票.name: ticket

斗.def: to struggle, to fight, to contend; measuring cup

ety.hint: A hand holding a measuring dipper

origin.says: A picture of a long-handled dipper for measuring grain. The simplified form also took over 鬥 (fight), a picture of two people wrestling.

斗.name: dipper

充.def: to fill, to supply; to be full

origin.says: An upside-down newborn child (亠 over 厶) above 儿 (legs, a standing person): a child grows up to stand tall, then to fill out, to fill. Early forms are poorly attested.

充.name: fill up

origin.says: From 韓: 韋 (surround) for the meaning plus 倝 (sunrise) as the sound; said first to mean the frame around a well, then a state name and surname. 韋 is written 韦, and the 人 (person) of 倝 is not visible.

坏.def: bad, rotten, spoiled; to break down

origin.says: Stands for 壞: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus a complex sound part, replaced by 不 (not) in the simplified form; what rots returns to earth: bad, broken. 坏 was already an old variant of a different word, 'unfired brick'.

坏.name: broken

双.def: pair, couple; both; measure word for things that come in pairs

origin.says: Simplified from 雙: a hand (又) holding two birds (隹 隹): a pair. The simplified form drops the birds and doubles the hand, 又 + 又, two hands side by side.

双.name: both hands

镇.def: calm, composed; to control, to suppress

origin.says: Simplified from 鎮: 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 真 (true) as the sound: a metal weight that presses down; hence to suppress, to calm, and a market town (a garrison place).

镇.name: paperweight

副.def: to assist, to supplement; assistant; secondary; auxiliary

origin.says: 刂 (knife) for the meaning plus 畐 (full jar) as the sound: first to split in two; a second half or copy, hence 'deputy, secondary'.

副.name: deputy

origin.says: 阝 (mound) for the meaning plus 艮 (stubborn) as the sound: a ridge that stops you, a limit or boundary.

密.def: secret, confidential; intimate, close; dense, thick

ety.hint: A silent 宓 mountain 山; 宓 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 宓 (quiet, hidden) as the sound plus 山 (mountain) for the meaning: tucked away in the mountains, secret, close, dense.

密.name: secret

ety.hint: To give someone food 羊 and conversation 口

origin.says: Bronze forms show 羊 (sheep, a sign of good luck) between two 言 (speech), perhaps as the sound: good, kind words. Later one 言 remained, and it has since merged into the bottom shape.

束.def: to bind, to control, to restrain; bale

ety.hint: Lumber 木 bound by rope 口

origin.says: A picture of a bag or bundle tied at both ends: to bind, a bundle.

束.name: bundle

origin.says: Simplified from 媽 (mother): 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 馬 (horse) as the sound, with 馬 written in its short form 马.
One reading: first 歀, 柰 as the sound plus 欠 (lacking, longing): desire, sincerity; 木 in 柰 later became 士. Shuowen reads it differently. Now funds and items.
A drawing of husked grains scattered above and below a line: rice or millet grain, hulled rice; also used for the metre.

米.name: rice
米.in: 数类料断继精楼迷粉粮糕糟糊糖粗粹粒谜粘屡菊粥渊糙搂屎鞠粟眯咪籽娄粪缕粱篓磷糠鳞糯

拉.def: to pull, to drag; to seize, to hold; to lengthen; to play (a violin)

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 立 (stand) as the sound: it first meant to break or snap, later 'to pull'.

拉.name: pull

origin.says: Traditional 鐵: 金 (metal) plus a complex sound part: iron. The simplified form writes 金 as 钅 and replaces the sound part with 失 (lose), which sounds similar.

修.def: to study; to repair; to decorate; to cultivate

origin.says: 攸 (a person being washed) as the sound plus 彡 (decoration strokes) for the meaning: to adorn and tidy, then to repair and cultivate. Its 攵 is written 夂.

修.name: repair

释.def: to explain, to interpret; to release

origin.says: 釆 (to sort out) for the meaning plus 睪 (to spy, release) as the sound: to set apart, explain, let go. Simplified from 釋 by writing 睪 as 𠬤.

释.name: explain

犯.def: criminal; to violate, to commit a crime

origin.says: 犭 (dog) for the meaning plus 𢎘 (now written 㔾) as the sound: a dog overstepping, to offend against, to commit a crime.

犯.name: offender

穿.def: to drill, to pierce; to dress, to wear

origin.says: 穴 (hole) plus 牙 (tooth): teeth boring a hole, to pierce through; later to thread, and to put on clothes.

穿.name: pierce

origin.says: 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 艮 (stubborn) as the sound: silver, and so money. Simplified from 銀, with 金 (metal) written 钅.

著.def: to show, to prove, to make known

origin.says: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 者 as the sound; the word meant 'to put, to place', hence to show, to make known, to write a book, and the grammar particle zhe.

著.name: renowned

origin.says: 囗 (enclosure, fence) for the meaning plus a sound part: a fenced garden. Traditional 園 had 袁 as the sound; the simplified form uses the simpler 元 (first).

答.def: answer, reply; to return; to assent to

origin.says: 𥫗 (bamboo) plus 合 (join) as the sound: to answer, respond. The bamboo is unexplained; the word was earlier written 荅 (a kind of bean, with 艹 grass), whose top was later replaced by bamboo.

答.name: answer

拍.def: to clap, to tap; to hit, to beat, to slap; beat, rhythm

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 白 (white) as the sound: to strike with the hand, to clap.

拍.name: clap

origin.says: Simplified from 謝: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 射 (shoot) as the sound; first to decline or take leave, later to thank. 言 became 讠.

青.def: nature's color; blue, green, black; young

origin.says: Built from 生 (growing plant) and 井 (well); one reading takes both as sound parts, another (old dictionary) 生 plus 丹 (cinnabar): the color of growing plants. The parts have warped into the top and bottom seen today.

青.name: blue-green
青.in: 情请清精静睛猜晴靖蜻

克.def: to subdue, to restrain, to overcome; used in transliterations

ety.hint: A weapon 十 used to subdue a beast 兄

origin.says: Origin uncertain: one reading sees a person bearing a heavy load, able to bear it, to overcome; another sees a head over an overturned basin. The modern shape looks like 古 (old) over 儿 (legs).

克.name: overcome

origin.says: From 緊: 臤 (firm, a hand gripping) as the sound plus 糸 (thread) for the meaning: thread pulled tight. 臤 was shortened, 臣 becoming two short strokes.

停.def: to suspend, to halt, to delay; suitable

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 亭 (pavilion) as the sound and hint: a person stopping at a roadside lodge, to halt.

停.name: halt

ety.hint: A rhinoceros or other animal horn

origin.says: A drawing of an animal horn; hence also corner and angle.

略.def: approximate, rough; outline, summary; plan, plot

origin.says: 田 (field) for the meaning plus 各 (each) as the sound: walking around a field to mark it out, hence an outline, a rough plan, to leave out details.

略.name: outline

享.def: to share; to enjoy; to benefit from

ety.hint: Children 子 living and eating 口 in the house 亠

origin.says: A drawing of an ancestral shrine, where offerings were presented; the meaning shifted to feasting and to enjoying. The bottom of the shrine was later written like 子 (child).

享.name: enjoy

靠.def: nearby; to depend on, to lean on, to trust

origin.says: 非 (two sides back to back) for the meaning plus 告 (tell) as the sound: backs against each other, to lean on and depend on.

靠.name: rely on

origin.says: 宀 (roof) for the meaning plus 畐 (full jar) as the sound and sense: a house full of goods, rich.

ety.hint: Words passing through ten 十 mouths 口

origin.says: Origin unclear. One reading: a shield with a mouth 口 added as a mark, first meaning 'firm' (now 固, solid); another: words passed down through ten 十 mouths. Now it means old, ancient.

古.name: ancient
古.in: 做据故居克剧苦估固湖姑胡糊辜摘滴蝴枯菇锯兢咕沽葫嘀

origin.says: The origin is unclear: one reading takes it as a drawing of an arrow tip, used early on like another character; the meaning a long time is a sound use. The shape is not split.

ety.hint: A jar 酉 of wine 氵; 酉 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 氵 (water, liquid) for the meaning plus 酉 (wine jar) as the sound and meaning: the liquid in the wine jar. 酉 alone first wrote the word; water was added later to tell them apart.

ety.hint: A person 㔾 at the edge of a cliff 厃; 厃 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 厃 (a person on top of a cliff) plus 㔾 (a kneeling person): someone perched at a cliff edge, in danger. An older form put 人 (person) on 山 (mountain).
欠 (open mouth breathing out) for the meaning plus 區 (area) as the sound: to vomit (now 呕). Used for its sound for 'Europe'. Simplified by writing 區 as 区.

介.def: agent, go-between, intermediary; to introduce; shell, armor

ety.hint: A border 八 dividing people 人

origin.says: 人 (person) with two marks on either side: a person standing in between, a go-between; later also armour and 'to introduce'.

介.name: go-between

训.def: to teach, to instruct; pattern, example; exegesis

origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 川 (river) as the sound: guiding by words, to teach and instruct. Simplified from 訓 (言 → 讠).

训.name: instruct

ety.hint: A container 皿 overflowing with water 水

origin.says: Water (水, lying on its side at the top) over 皿 (vessel): a vessel overflowing, the original of 溢 (overflow); hence increase, benefit.

ety.hint: A painting on an easel; compare 畫, which includes the brush

origin.says: Simplified from 畫, a hand holding a brush 聿 (brush) over a drawn design: to draw. The simplified form drops the brush and keeps the drawing, a frame round 田 (field).

排.def: row, rank, file; to eliminate, to remove

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 非 as the sound: to push things into line by hand, to arrange in rows; also to push away, to eliminate.

排.name: line up

升.def: to advance; to arise; to hoist, to raise

origin.says: A picture of a dipper or ladle (compare 斗 'dipper'), a measure of grain; from lifting the ladle came 'to rise, to raise'.

升.name: ascend

origin.says: Old forms draw a person with a swollen belly or chest; the word for that was borrowed early for 'yellow'. Another reading sees a jade pendant. The modern shape no longer shows the figure.

剧.def: theatrical plays, opera, drama; severe, acute

origin.says: 刂 (knife) for the meaning plus a sound part: fierce, severe, later a drama. Simplified from 劇, where the hard sound part 豦 was replaced by the similar-sounding 居 (reside).

剧.name: opera

ety.hint: Two trees 木 representing a forest

origin.says: Two 木 (tree) side by side: many trees, a grove or forest.

林.name: grove
林.in: 梦嘛楚禁麻森摩磨魔淋婪焚靡襟彬琳蘑

origin.says: 行 (crossroads) pulled apart around 圭 (jade tablet), which gives the sound: a street.

配.def: to blend, to mix; to fit, to match

origin.says: One reading: 酉 (wine jar) with a kneeling person 卩 (kneeling person) beside it, mixing wine; the person later looked like 己 (self). Other sources take 己 as the sound. To blend, to match.

配.name: match

临.def: to draw near, to approach; to descend

origin.says: Simplified from 臨 (to look down on): a person bending over with a big eye 臣 (eye) looking down at many things 品 (articles), which also gave the sound. The cursive shorthand reduced it to a few strokes, so the build no longer shows.

临.name: look down
